item.title: Trump touts airman rescue mission, boasts Iran could be 'taken out in 1 night'
item.summary: Trump calls the rescue of F-15e airmen behind enemy lines in Iran "very historic" and warns the country could be "taken out" by Tuesday night.

item.title: ‘God is good’: Inside the high-risk US mission to save a wounded airman shot down in Iran
item.summary: Hundreds of U.S. commandos launched a high-stakes rescue mission deep inside Iran to extract a wounded airman who evaded Iranian forces for two days.

item.title: Top GOP defense voice breaks with invasion fears, says US can reopen Hormuz without ground war
item.summary: Rep. Mike Turner says he doesn't think U.S. ground troops will be necessary to open the Strait of Hormuz amid Trump's escalating threats to Iran.

item.title: NPR public editor admits glaring absence of Jewish victim's voices in coverage of Michigan synagogue attack
item.summary: The NPR public editor admitted important Jewish voices were missing from coverage of the March attack on Temple Israel synagogue in West Bloomfield, Michigan.

item.title: Mauro compares Iran rescue of missing colonel to Maduro capture, credits intelligence preparation
item.summary: Paul Mauro says U.S. intelligence agencies had already laid the groundwork needed to locate and rescue a missing colonel from enemy territory in Iran.

item.title: CENTCOM commander directed strike against an IRGC headquarters in underground facility: sources
item.summary: U.S. Central Command Commander Admiral Brad Cooper directed a strike on an IRGC headquarters in an underground facility, sources indicated.

item.title: Left-wing toolkit from college professors group urges students to ‘create a crisis’ over ICE
item.summary: Left-wing groups, including one representing colleg professors, produced a student toolkit encouraging campaigns against ICE by targeting corporate contracts at hundreds of colleges.

item.title: White House Egg Roll for Easter features Trump family members amid festive celebration
item.summary: President Trump and first lady Melania Trump hosted the White House Easter Egg Roll on the South Lawn of the White House, with patriotic and festive activities.

item.title: 'Full House' star Dave Coulier warns 'everything in my life was toxic' before cancer battle
item.summary: "Full House" star Dave Coulier opens up about replacing toxic everyday products after surviving two cancer diagnoses, inspiring his new venture Awear Market.

item.title: 'The View' co-host claims show's criticism of having children was 'misconstrued'
item.summary: Sara Haines said her comments on marriage and motherhood were misunderstood after responding to Isabel Brown’s remarks encouraging Gen Z women to prioritize family life.
